changes.summary: Refuse billing refunds that have no captured money or an invalid amount, and serialize Cancel, Refund and Delete with a row lock. billing.Repository gains GetByIDForUpdate, so custom implementations must add it.
Render ungrouped filter builder reference fields with fewer than five options as a checkbox list instead of a searchable combobox.
Keep selected reference values that are no longer available as options visible and removable in the filter builder checkbox list.

Lens report picker opens as a right-side drawer with whole-row selection, an optional ReportCatalogHost.generate that creates one report from a plain-language description, new report.picker.generate.* runtime strings, and a zero-specificity pointer cursor for every enabled interactive control in the Lens stylesheet.
Classify the notification delivery-channel mutations in the business history coverage matrix so the coverage test passes again.
Preserve decimal minor units when creating money from floats while truncating excess fractional digits toward zero.

Add notification delivery channels (email, SMS, push) with provider adapters, per-channel delivery state and retry, channel selection on event rules, per-user channel opt-outs and explicit addressed sends.
Add notification definition sources: runtime definitions bound to an immutable snapshot reference, atomic registration, deactivation that keeps pending deliveries renderable.
Publish the server-resolved shell navigation from layouts.Authenticated and read it into one shared ShellRegistry per document.
Add ShellRegistry to the client host: extension navigation items, rename/move/hide patches, header and footer contributions with owner disposal and conflict diagnostics.

Add ShellHost for a single app-wide shell renderer with outlet handoff and standard-shell fallback, publish the signed-in user in the shell context, and move the Lens drawer onto the shared document portal registry.
